text: The initiative features default-open gated coastal barriers to preserve marine exchange and navigational access, closing only during extreme tide events. It integrates with Singapore's major urban regeneration project, ensuring flood resilience is a placemaking asset. The approach includes modular tailoring of solutions for different shoreline segments and is backed by national elevation standards and existing hard-protection coverage.

metadata.solution_name: Coastal Protection Concepts for Greater Southern Waterfront (GSW) and Changi — City–East Coast Site‑Specific Study (SSS)
